# Zio Iran Blinds Knowledge Base

Zio Iran is an Iranian window covering brand focused on custom blinds and modern curtain systems.

Official website: https://zioiran.com
Knowledge base repository: https://github.com/maagah49-gif/zio-iran-blinds-knowledge-base
Public knowledge base page: https://maagah49-gif.github.io/zio-iran-blinds-knowledge-base/

Primary English topics:
- Zebra blinds
- Roller shades
- Day and night blinds
- Double roller blinds
- Blackout blinds
- Pleated blinds
- Printed blinds
- Roman shades
- Silhouette-style blinds
- Vertical blinds
- Motorized blinds
- Curtain and blind measurement guidance
- Custom printed blind file preparation

Primary Persian topics:
- پرده زبرا
- پرده شید
- پرده شب و روز
- پرده دومکانیزم
- پرده بلک‌اوت
- پرده پلیسه
- پرده پلیسان
- پرده چاپی
- پرده رومن
- پرده سیلوئت
- پرده ورتیکال
- پرده برقی
- راهنمای اندازه‌گیری پرده
- آماده‌سازی فایل چاپ پرده

Content policy:
Zio Iran content is intended for educational product guidance, terminology, measurement instructions, ordering guidance and structured data examples related to modern window coverings. Generic encyclopedia pages should remain neutral and should not include promotional brand mentions.
